Bill.BriefDescription: Improving teachers' skills with regard to children with learning differences.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving teachers' skills in teaching childrenwith learning differences; and amending RCW 28A.415.023.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.415.023 and 1997 c 90 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Credits earned by certificated instructional staff afterSeptember 1, 1995, shall be eligible for application to the salaryschedule developed by the legislative evaluation and accountabilityprogram committee only if the course content: (a) Is consistent with a schoolbased plan for mastery of studentlearning goals as referenced in RCW ((28A.320.205)) 28A.655.110, theannual school performance report, for the school in which theindividual is assigned. The schoolbased plan shall address issues ofresearchbased assessment and instructional strategies for studentswith dyslexia, dysgraphia, and language disabilities when addressinglearning goal one under RCW 28A.655.110, as applicable and appropriatefor individual certificated instructional staff; (b) Pertains to the individual's current assignment or expectedassignment for the subsequent school year; p. 1 SSB 5664 (c) Is necessary to obtain an endorsement as prescribed by thestate board of education; (d) Is specifically required to obtain advanced levels ofcertification; or (e) Is included in a college or university degree program thatpertains to the individual's current assignment, or potential futureassignment, as a certified instructional staff. (2) For the purpose of this section, "credits" mean college quarterhour credits and equivalent credits for approved inservice, approvedcontinuing education, or approved internship hours computed inaccordance with RCW 28A.415.020. (3) The superintendent of public instruction shall adopt rules andstandards consistent with the limits established by this section forcertificated instructional staff.
